user_prompt: Competitive positioning quadrant diagram for AI verification market. Four quadrants labeled: Top-Left 'Vendor-Controlled Verification' (high vendor control, low independence), Top-Right 'Independent Buyer Verification' (high independence, high buyer control - Ontitled's claimed position), Bottom-Left 'Self-Reported Outcomes' (low verification, low independence), Bottom-Right 'Cross-Vendor Standards' (high independence, vendor-agnostic). Plot competitors: Nevermined in bottom-left, Braintrust in top-left, Zendesk/Intercom/Sierra in top-left slightly right, ServiceNow AI Control Tower spanning left side, Paid.ai in bottom-left. Show Ontitled's target position in top-right quadrant with dashed outline. Use blue for buyer-control axis, orange for independence axis. Clean professional style with clear labels.
